title: Is your site ready to migrate to Astro?
subtitle: 15 questions, about 3 minutes. Get your Migration Need and Migration Complexity scores with a clear recommendation.

scoring.formula: percent = round(points / max * 100); high if percent >= threshold

questions.question: Which platform is your website built on?
What role does your website play in your business?

answers.label: A digital business card, few people visit it
It supports sales, but most deals come from elsewhere
It's one of our main sources of leads or sign-ups
It's the core of our business

questions.question: What's your site's mobile PageSpeed score?
questions.helper: Not sure? Run your homepage through pagespeed.web.dev and check the Performance score on the Mobile tab.

questions.question: How important are Google and AI search tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity) for bringing you customers?

answers.label: Not important, our traffic comes from elsewhere
Important, it's one of our main channels

questions.question: How often does your platform stop you from building what you want?
questions.helper: Think of CMS limits, design restrictions, or features and integrations you had to give up on.

answers.label: Often, we pay for extra tools or developers to get around it
Constantly, it's blocking things we need

questions.question: How much do you spend on your website platform per year?
questions.helper: Include the site plan, hosting, paid plugins or apps and extra editor seats. Leave out agency or developer fees.

questions.question: How much time goes into keeping the site running?
questions.helper: Updates, plugin conflicts, broken layouts, security fixes.

answers.label: A lot, things break and we've had security scares

questions.question: Are you planning a redesign or rebrand?

answers.label: No, the current design is staying

questions.question: How many pages does your site have?
questions.helper: Count unique pages like Home, About and Pricing. Don't count individual blog posts.

questions.question: How much CMS content do you have?
questions.helper: Blog posts, case studies, team members, job listings, docs and similar.

answers.label: Over 1,000 items, or many linked collections

questions.question: Who updates the site, and how often?

answers.label: One person updates it now and then
Our marketing team edits it every week
Several people publish daily, with drafts and approvals

questions.question: How many tools are connected to your site?
questions.helper: Forms, CRM, newsletter, booking, search, analytics, chat widgets.

answers.label: Custom integrations or APIs built for us

questions.question: Does your site sell products or have user logins?

answers.label: No, or we link out to a separate store or app
A few products or simple payment links

questions.question: How many languages is your site in?

answers.label: Six or more, or different content per region

questions.question: How much animation and interactivity does your site have?

answers.label: Some hover effects and simple animations
Lots of scroll animations, sliders and interactions
It's an experience: 3D, WebGL or complex custom interactions

results.label: Migrate now
results.headline: Your site is a prime candidate for Astro
results.body: Your current platform is costing you speed, money or flexibility, and your site is simple enough to move quickly. This is the best-case migration: a faster site with less overhead, without a drawn-out project.
results.ctaNote: Every migration comes with a 90+ mobile PageSpeed guarantee, or I keep working for free.

results.label: Migrate with a plan
results.headline: Astro will pay off, but plan the move
results.body: Your site has real reasons to migrate and enough moving parts that it needs a phased plan. Mapping content, integrations and redirects first protects your traffic and keeps the launch on schedule.

results.label: Easy upgrade, no rush
results.headline: You could move anytime, but there's no fire
results.body: Your site works well enough today, and moving it would be straightforward. Astro makes the most sense when you're planning a redesign or want to cut platform costs.

results.label: Optimize first
results.headline: Get more from the site you have
results.body: A migration would be a big project with limited upside right now. You'll see faster returns from tuning your current site's speed and search visibility.

items.message: Astro can run stores and member areas through connected services, but they add scope. We'll map this part separately on the call.
Planning a redesign anyway? Doing it together with the migration means you only pay for the build once.
Search is your #1 channel, so the migration includes full redirect mapping and schema checks to protect your rankings.
Your team publishes a lot. We'll choose an editing setup that keeps publishing as easy as it is today.
Your site is already fast. Here the case for Astro is cost, flexibility or AI visibility, not raw speed.
Run your homepage through pagespeed.web.dev before we talk. It's the quickest way to see what you're losing.
